Version 1.0.5

- Updated SKILL.md: Version bumped, description and metadata refreshed.

- User identity (open-id) handling is now fully automatic and internal—users are no longer asked to provide username/phone; scripts manage identity invisibly.

- Historical report queries are unified: always use the cloud API, never local or memory records.

- Overall experience simplified: users provide input only (video/url), all identification, report listing, and results management are handled transparently.

Version 1.0.1

- Updated file structure: relocated configuration files and cleaned up unused components.
- Adjusted open-id retrieval logic; config.yaml is now fetched from scripts/config.yaml in the skill directory instead of under skills/smyx_analysis.
- Updated documentation and usage flows in SKILL.md for improved clarity and consistency.

- No behavioral changes to core analysis logic; API invocation pattern and alerting remain consistent.

- Initial release of smyx-driver-head-pose-abnormality-analysis.
- Real-time detection of driver head pose (pitch/yaw) using in-cabin DMS camera.
- Raises distracted-driving alerts and voice reminders when head-down (>30°) or side-view yaw (>45°) exceed thresholds for over 2 seconds.
- Logs distraction events and provides historical query/report functionality, with strict open-id retrieval rules for data access.
- Designed for integration with dashcams, smart in-vehicle devices, and fleet management systems.
- Supports both English and Chinese usage instructions and safety notices.
